comments.author: @Sharonbowley-y3c
comments.text: At 3:45 my home town Porthleven in Cornwall.  I used to walk home sometimes along the road with crashing huge waves, sometimes wondering if I would make it and time it just right.  When I was young my Grandfather was a police officer patrolling along that road one evening and he witnessed his colleagues in another patrol car just in front by a few seconds get washed into the outer harbour. They were killed, no chance of rescue. There are many other tragedies there also. It is spectacular to watch the big waves crashing over the road and sometimes hitting the houses above. But get to close you can say goodbye.
